item.description:
1.4.3

  • 1 优化翻页动画。
  • 2 优化触摸板和鼠标滚轮翻页逻辑。

1.4.2

  • 1 修复macOS 27无法获取桌面壁纸问题。
  • 2 优化翻页动画，翻页动画更加流畅。
  • 3 修复部分情况下鼠标滚轮无法翻页问题。
  • 4 支持触摸板2指和3指上下滑动翻页。
  • 5 优化窗口模式布局显示。

1.4.1

  • 1 修复右键发送到页面遗留的空白页未删除问题。
  • 2 修复在分组子页面中跨页拖动App，行数发生变化分组页面高度未刷新问题。

1.4.0

  • 1 支持自定义行列数。
  • 2 支持调整图标大小。
  • 3 支持配置App数据来源的目录。
  • 4 支持全屏模式下隐藏程序坞。
  • 5 右键增加移动到页面功能。
  • 6 支持长按App进入卸载模式。
  • 7 修复拖拽App翻页偶发崩溃问题。

1.4.3

  • 1 Optimized page-turning animations.
  • 2 Optimized page-turning logic for the touchpad and mouse wheel.

1.4.2

  • 1 Fixed the issue where desktop wallpaper could not be retrieved on macOS 27.
  • 2 Optimized the page-turning animation, making it smoother.
  • 3 Fixed the issue where the mouse wheel could not turn pages in some cases.
  • 4 Support two-finger and three-finger swipe up/down on the trackpad to turn pages.
  • 5 Optimized the layout display in windowed mode.

1.4.1

  • 1 Fixed an issue where a blank page remained after using the "Send to" (right-click) function.
  • 2 Fixed an issue where the height of a grouped sub-page failed to update when dragging an app across pages caused a change in the number of rows.

1.4.0

  • 1 Support customizable number of rows and columns.
  • 2 Support adjusting icon size.
  • 3 Support configuring the directory for App data sources.
  • 4 Support hiding the Dock in full-screen mode.
  • 5 Add a "Move to Page" option to the right-click menu.
  • 6 Support long-pressing an App to enter uninstall mode.
  • 7 Fixed an occasional crash when dragging an App to turn pages.
